message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise‑complaint with the City of Atlanta.  
In the U.S., “local council” usually refers to the city’s governing body, and the City of Atlanta handles noise complaints through its Police Department and online portal.

**How to file a noise complaint in Atlanta**

| Step | What to do | Where / How |
|------|------------|-------------|
| 1 | **Call 311** (or 404‑656‑4000) | If you’re in Atlanta, dial 311 from any phone. The dispatcher will connect you to the appropriate department. |
| 2 | **Use the online form** | Visit the City of Atlanta’s official website: <https://www.atlantaga.gov> → “Services” → “Noise Complaint.” Fill out the required fields (date, time, location, description). |
| 3 | **Submit the form** | Click “Submit.” You’ll receive a confirmation email or text with a reference number. |
| 4 | **Follow up** | If you don’t hear back within a few days, call 311 again and provide your reference number. |

**Key points**

* Noise complaints are handled by the **Atlanta Police Department**.  
* The city’s noise ordinance is available on the website under “City Code” → “Noise.”  
* For urgent or emergency situations, call 911.  

**Contact information**

| Service | Phone | Website |
|---------|-------|---------|
| 311 (non‑emergency) | 404‑656‑4000 | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311> |
| Noise Complaint (online) | – | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/services/noise-complaint> |
| City of Atlanta Police | 404‑656‑4000 | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/police> |

So yes—just use the city’s official channels (phone or online) to report the noise issue.
